service.description: Each role the two-factor policy covers (ADMIN, DARPAN_SUPER_ADMIN, DARPAN_ADMIN, DARPAN_TENANT_ADMIN in any tenant) with its date and who in it is and is not enrolled, plus how many super admins are enrolled (the break-glass rule needs two before super-admin enforcement can be switched on).

parameter.name: policies
parameter.description: One entry per role, in the order above.

parameter.name: requiredFromDate
parameter.description: Empty: optional. Future: grace period.

parameter.name: enrolledSuperAdminCount
parameter.description: Super admins (ADMIN, DARPAN_SUPER_ADMIN) with two-factor on.

service.description: Require two-factor for a role from a date (today or earlier: now; later: a grace period during which sign-in prompts), or make it optional again (clear). Super admins only, with a current code from their own authenticator app or a passkey assertion (so they must have two-factor on). Requiring it for ADMIN or DARPAN_SUPER_ADMIN is refused until at least two super admins have it on. Writes an AdminAuditLog row.

parameter.name: permissionGroupId
parameter.description: ADMIN, DARPAN_SUPER_ADMIN, DARPAN_ADMIN or DARPAN_TENANT_ADMIN.

parameter.name: requiredFromDate
parameter.description: Required from this date. Leave out with clear.

parameter.name: clear
parameter.description: True makes the role optional again.

parameter.name: adminCode
parameter.description: A current code from the acting admin's own authenticator app (or adminPasskeyAssertion).

parameter.name: adminPasskeyAssertion
parameter.description: Instead of adminCode: a passkey assertion over facade.AuthFacadeServices.begin#PasskeyProof's options.

parameter.name: ok
parameter.description: True when the policy was saved.

return.message: ${permissionGroupId ?: '(missing)'} is not a role the two-factor policy covers (${policyGroupIds.join(', ')}).
Give requiredFromDate, or clear=true to make it optional.
At least ${minimumSuperAdmins} super admins must have two-factor on before it is required for ${permissionGroupId} (${enrolledSuperAdminCount} do).
Set up two-factor on your own account before changing the two-factor policy.

service-call.name: store#darpan.auth.TwoFactorRolePolicy
service-call.in-map: [permissionGroupId: permissionGroupId, requiredFromDate: requiredFromDate, lastChangedByUserId: ec.user.userId, lastChangedDate: ec.user.nowTimestamp]

service-call.name: create#darpan.admin.AdminAuditLog
service-call.in-map: [adminUserId: ec.user.userId, serviceName: 'admin.SecurityAdminServices.update#TwoFactorPolicy', targetType: 'TwoFactorPolicy', targetId: permissionGroupId, detailText: requiredFromDate == null ? 'Two-factor optional for ' + permissionGroupId + '.' : 'Two-factor required for ' + permissionGroupId + ' from ' + requiredFromDate + '.', auditTimestamp: ec.user.nowTimestamp]

service.description: Re-encrypt every stored encrypted field (tenant connector credentials, two-factor secrets) with the current key, or with dryRun (the default) only report which key each value is on. Super admins only, with a current code from their own authenticator app or (DAR-BE-270) a passkey assertion. A real run is refused unless an old key different from the current one is configured (entity_ds_crypt_pass_old). Writes an AdminAuditLog row with counts, never values.

parameter.name: adminCode
parameter.description: A current code from the acting admin's own authenticator app (or adminPasskeyAssertion).

parameter.name: adminPasskeyAssertion
parameter.description: DAR-BE-270. Instead of adminCode: a passkey assertion over facade.AuthFacadeServices.begin#PasskeyProof's options.

parameter.name: dryRun
parameter.description: True (default): count only, write nothing. False: run the sweep.

parameter.name: ok
parameter.description: True when the check (and the sweep, on a real run) ran.

parameter.name: oldKeyConfigured
parameter.description: An old key different from the current one is wired in.

parameter.name: rotationPending
parameter.description: Some value is still on the old key only (after the sweep, on a real run).

parameter.name: valueCount
parameter.description: Non-empty encrypted values stored.

parameter.name: currentKeyCount
parameter.description: Values the current key decrypts.

parameter.name: oldKeyOnlyCount
parameter.description: Values only the old key decrypts: the sweep rewrites them.

parameter.name: undecryptableCount
parameter.description: Values no configured key decrypts: the sweep leaves them; the tenant re-enters that credential.

parameter.name: entities
parameter.description: One entry per entity with encrypted fields, after the sweep on a real run.

parameter.name: reencryptedByEntity
parameter.description: Real run only: entity name to rows re-encrypted.

parameter.name: totalRows
parameter.description: Real run only: rows re-encrypted.

return.message: Set up two-factor on your own account before rotating the encryption key.

Nothing to rotate: no old key is configured (entity_ds_crypt_pass_old is unset or the same as the current key). Wire the key being retired in (CryptPassOldSecretArn on AWS), restart, then run this again.

set.from: 'Rotation: re-encrypted ' + totalRows + ' rows across ' + reencryptedByEntity.size() + ' entities; now ' + darpan.common.CryptRotationSupport.keyCheckSummary(check) + '.'

service-call.name: create#darpan.admin.AdminAuditLog
service-call.in-map: [adminUserId: ec.user.userId, serviceName: 'admin.SecurityAdminServices.rotate#EncryptedFields', targetType: 'EncryptedFields', targetId: 'ALL', detailText: detailText, auditTimestamp: ec.user.nowTimestamp]
